question: Which Act of the Government of India ensures the ‘right to work’ from the following?

options.text: The Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) is an Indian labor law and social security measure that aims to guarantee the 'right to work'.
 
• It was enacted on 23 August 2005, under the UPA government led by Prime Minister Manmohan Singh.
 
• MGNREGA aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• This act is a significant step towards the realization of the right to work and ensuring livelihood security in rural areas of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act**

 
 
• This is an Act to provide for the institution of provident funds, pension fund, and deposit-linked insurance fund for employees in factories and other establishments.
 
• It aims to ensure financial security for employees post-retirement.
 
 
 
• **Citizenship Act**
 
 
• This Act provides for the acquisition and determination of Indian citizenship.
 
• It deals with various modes of acquiring citizenship and the obligations of the citizens.
 
 
 
• **Indian Institutes of Management Act**
 
 
• This Act declares certain institutions of management to be of national importance and provides for their incorporation and other matters connected therewith.
 
• It aims to empower these institutions to attain standards of global excellence in management education.
